entities.summary: Tuleutai Suleimenov is a Soviet and Kazakh diplomat, who served as the First Minister of Foreign Affairs of Kazakhstan, Ambassador of Kazakhstan to the European Union in 2003. He previously served as the ambassador to the United States from 1994 to 1996.
